items.title: Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT) Agrees Utility Deal To Deepen AI Data Center Power Reach
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE:VRT) agreed to acquire Utility Innovation Holdings to expand its role in AI data center power infrastructure. The planned deal adds grid interconnect, microgrid controls, and onsite generation capabilities to Vertiv's existing power and cooling portfolio. The acquisition targets growing demand for reliable power solutions for AI data centers as grid constraints become a bigger concern for operators.
